messages:
maria: heads-up — several staging customers started hitting 401s right after the key rotator ran at ~02:15 UTC. proxy logs show "invalid api key" on token compare. any quick guesses? :thinking_face:

aj: can you paste a sample proxy log and the repro steps you used? are these new keys from the vault rotation job or from a manual put?

maria: rotation job triggered automatically. repro is: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" "https://staging-api.redwoodai.dev/v1/ping" -> 401. proxy log snippet: 

```
[2026-03-15T02:17:05Z] proxy: auth: key_lookup failed: key=redwood-staging-12345
[2026-03-15T02:17:05Z] proxy: auth: compare failed: provided_len=14 stored_len=13
[2026-03-15T02:17:05Z] proxy: auth: rejecting request, status=401
```

matt: interesting line: provided_len vs stored_len. that often points to hidden bytes like CRLF or BOM. did the vault value get edited on Windows or via some CI that might mangle encoding?

devon: i grabbed the secret from the kv store to inspect. dumping the raw bytes showed a BOM and UTF-16LE encoding. short hexdump: 

```
$ xxd -g 1 /tmp/apikey.bin | head
00000000: ff fe 41 00 50 00 49 00 5f 00 4b 00 45 00 59 00 5f 00 31 00 32 00
# ff fe = UTF-16LE BOM, then ASCII bytes interleaved with 00
```

claire: oh nice catch. so the stored secret actually starts with 0xff0xfe (BOM) and the proxy is doing a bytewise compare against the incoming header (utf8) so lengths differ and compare fails.

aj: how did UTF-16 get in there? any suspect CI or local editor?

maria: customer reported someone copied their key into Notepad++ then uploaded via our internal vault helper script. looks like the helper didn't normalise encoding.

devon: actionable fix: convert the secret to UTF-8 and re-put it, then rotate again to ensure consumers pull new value. quick commands we used: 

```
# detect BOM (unix)
xxd -g 1 /tmp/apikey.bin | head

# convert UTF-16LE -> UTF-8 and strip trailing CRs/newlines
iconv -f UTF-16LE -t UTF-8 /tmp/apikey.bin | tr -d '\r\n' > /tmp/apikey.utf8

# re-insert into vault (example)
vault kv put secret/staging/apikey value="$(cat /tmp/apikey.utf8)"
```

matt: note: if the secret is being mounted into pods via our init-container that writes env files, make sure the init-container doesn't use binary-mode write that preserves BOM. update init-container to run the iconv step if necessary.

claire: for rollout steps I recommend:
- re-put the cleaned UTF-8 secret into KV
- trigger a forced rotation (small TTL bump) so rotator issues new token variation
- restart staging edge pods (rolling restart of 2 replicas) to clear in-memory env caches
- purge CDN edge cache for the small subset of affected routes (we have a ttl for auth headers)

aj: until we rotate, is there a quick workaround for customers?

maria: told them to regen the key from the console (which writes correct UTF-8) or to re-copy using a UTF-8 aware editor. also gave a small script they can run locally to detect BOM: 

```
python - <<'PY'
with open('apikey.txt','rb') as f:
    b = f.read(4)
    print('starts with BOM?' , b.startswith(b'\xff\xfe') or b.startswith(b'\xef\bb\bf'))
PY
```

ops-bot: rotation-manager: auto-rotation job 2026-03-15T02:15:00Z attempted for secret secret/staging/apikey -> status=completed (w/ new value).

devon: follow-up note: we added a small pre-put validation hook in the vault helper to reject values containing a BOM (both UTF-8 and UTF-16). patch landed to staging: https://git.internal/redwood/vault-helper/pull/412 :white_check_mark:

matt: confirmed after cleaning and forcing restart requests are auth'ing normally now. tested with curl from staging jumpbox.

```
$ curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <fixed-key>" "https://staging-api.redwoodai.dev/v1/ping"
{"ok":true}
```

claire: closing loop with customer and leaving notes in the ticket that the root cause was a BOM/encoding issue introduced by copy/paste + helper. recommended docs update to call out encoding in the vault CLI guide.

maria: thanks all — marking as resolved. will follow up w/ a short KB article and a small onboarding blurb for non-unix users. :pray:

aj: nice catch by devon. good team fix.

ops-bot: incidentbot: resolved (staging-auth-401-bom)
